title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 4 Writing Task 2
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write about the following topic:
prompt:
Many museums charge for admission while others are free.

Do you think the advantages of charging people for admission to museums outweigh the disadvantages?
scenario: Many museums charge for admission while others are free.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
